email.sample:
Hello Rahim,

Our new Eid collection is here. Have a look: https://shop.example.com

Thank you for shopping with us.

sub.home: The flash sale, the top slides and how the rows slide.
sub.category: The list page: how many styles, sorting, filters and the top bar.
sub.product: What a product page shows: template, trust row, short policy lines, colour and size words, buttons, reviews.
sub.thanks: The page after an order: note, next steps, look-completing picks and the celebration.
sub.bag: How adding to the bag behaves, the bag drawer, help lines and picks.
sub.account: The tabs, offer banner, tracking and sign-in code words and list sizes.
sub.search: Words that mean the same, popular searches, the results panel and help answers.
sub.currency: The currency, language tag, time zone and digits the shop and the admin write with.
sub.email: How the shop’s offer e-mails are dressed: logo, colours, type face, footer line.
sub.cookie: A short cookie notice on a visitor’s first visit.
sub.appicon: What a phone shows when a visitor adds the shop to the home screen.

homeFlash.title: Flash sale
homeFlash.help: A timed sale row on the home page. Nothing shows until you set a sale up. A sale never changes a price: a card shows a struck price only where the shop’s price rule already allows it.

homeHero.title: Top slides
homeHero.help: The slider at the top of the home page: how many slides, from where and how fast.

homeSlider.title: Sliding rows
homeSlider.help: How every sliding row drifts, holds and snaps. The defaults are tuned; change only if a row feels wrong.

catList.title: The list
catList.help: How many styles show, how sold-out ones are treated and the small details at the top.

catSort.title: Sorting
catSort.help: Which ways a customer can sort the list, in your order. Add or take out an option.

catFilters.title: Filters
catFilters.help: Which filters show and in what order, and how colours, sizes and price steps are drawn.

catToolbar.title: Top bar and chips
catToolbar.help: The bar above the list and the quick chips. This is a list of settings written as text; change it only if you know what you need.

pdpTemplate.title: Page template
pdpTemplate.help: Which of the three product page designs the shop uses, and their own details.

pdpTrust.title: Trust row and rule cells
pdpTrust.help: The small reassurance row and the delivery / exchange / returns cells: which show and in what order.

pdpSummaries.title: Short policy lines
pdpSummaries.help: The one-line summaries of returns, exchange and order change on product and landing pages. {windowHours} and {maxEdits} fill in the shop’s own numbers.

pdpChoose.title: Colour, size and stock
pdpChoose.help: The words and helpers around choosing a colour and a size, the size chart and the stock line.

pdpBuy.title: Price, buttons and share
pdpBuy.help: The price line, the buy buttons, the share tiles and the fabric / fit / description blocks.

pdpSocial.title: Reviews and questions
pdpSocial.help: The review box and the questions and answers on a product page.

pdpRare.title: Gallery, icons, rows and finders
pdpRare.help: Less common product page settings: gallery, icon panel, suggestion rows, Find My Size and spacing.

thanksPage.title: After the order
thanksPage.help: What the thank-you page adds below the order summary.

thanksCelebrate.title: Celebration
thanksCelebrate.help: A short celebration animation when the page opens. Off until you turn it on.

bagAdding.title: Adding to the bag
bagAdding.help: What happens when a customer adds something, how long it is kept and the small guards.

bagDrawer.title: Bag drawer
bagDrawer.help: The panel that opens after adding.

bagHelp.title: Help and trust lines
bagHelp.help: Reassurance lines, WhatsApp help and the free-delivery bar in the bag.

bagUpsell.title: You may also like
bagUpsell.help: The picks shown in the bag.

bagTiers.title: Quantity offers and offer slot
bagTiers.help: The quantity-offer box, its dates and the offer slot in the bag.

acctTabs.title: Account tabs
acctTabs.help: Which tabs a customer sees in My account, in your order.

acctOffers.title: Offer banner
acctOffers.help: Offers shown at the top of the account page. Off until you turn it on.

acctTrack.title: Order tracking
acctTrack.help: The welcome line and the late-order notice on the tracking page.

loginCode.title: Sign-in code message
loginCode.help: The text of the SMS that carries a customer’s sign-in code. {code}, {store} and {minutes} fill in by themselves.

acctLists.title: List sizes and small switches
acctLists.help: How many rows each list shows, how many addresses a customer may keep and the history helpers.

acctReorder.title: Buy again
acctReorder.help: The Buy again button on past orders and its words. Off until you turn it on.

searchWords.title: Words that mean the same
searchWords.help: Teach search that “tee” means “t-shirt”. Phrases are joined into one word, synonyms find each other, and common words are ignored.

searchPanel.title: Search box and results
searchPanel.help: The panel that opens under the search box and the results page: how many of each, and the popular searches.

searchPopular.title: Popular searches from real searches
searchPopular.help: Show what visitors really search for. Off until you turn it on.

searchHelp.title: Help answers in search
searchHelp.help: The words that make search show a help answer (delivery, exchange, payment …).

searchMatch.title: Spelling slips
searchMatch.help: How many typos search forgives and whether a half-typed word matches.

moneyTime.title: Currency, language and time
moneyTime.help: These change how amounts, dates and numbers are written everywhere. They never convert a price.

emailLook.title: E-mail look
emailLook.help: Off, the e-mails stay plain. Turn it on to dress every offer e-mail. The picture below is a sample.

cookieBanner.title: Cookie banner
cookieBanner.help: Off, no banner shows. A visitor’s choice is remembered for the days you set.

appHome.title: Home-screen icon
appHome.help: Off, the shop gives no home-screen details. Use a square picture, at least 512 px.

f.home.flashRows/fillTo: Repeat a short sale up to
f.home.heroSlides/collection: Use the products of this collection
f.category.page/breadcrumb: Show the path at the top
f.category.page/fewStyles: A short list is called “few” at (0 = never)
f.category.page/progress: Show “you have seen N of M”
f.category.newIn/days: Counts as new for (days, 0 = by order)
f.category.filters/priceCuts: Own price cuts per category (as text)
f.pdp.templates/perProduct: A product may choose its own
f.pdp.templates/t3/inlineFinder: Find My Size inside the page
f.pdp.sizeWords/words: Words for sizes (the size name, then its words)
f.pdp.stock/dispatchCutoff: Order before this time to ship today (HH:MM)
f.pdp.usualSize/preselect: Pick the usual size for them
f.thanks.page/noteBack: Note to go back to the shop
f.account.reorder/states: On orders that are (in order of the journey)
f.search.words/general: Common words to ignore (one per line)
f.search.help/weak: Words too weak to show a help answer (one per line)
f.language.bengali.digits: Bengali digits on the Bengali shop
f.cookie.banner/declineStops: A visitor who says No is not counted

h.home.flashSale/on: Switch off to pause it without losing it.
h.home.flashSale/startsAt: Leave empty to start at once. Uses this device’s clock.
h.home.flashSale/endsAt: The clock counts down to this; the row hides itself at zero.
h.home.flashSale/collection: Make a collection of the products you want in Products › Collections and pick it here.
h.home.flashRows/onlyMarkdowns: A card shows only if the price rule allows a struck price.
h.home.flashRows/fillTo: So both rows can glide even with few products.
h.home.heroSlides/collection: To choose the slide products by hand, make a collection of them in Products › Collections and pick it here. Empty = the shop picks from every category in turn.
h.category.sort/options: The first one is the list’s own order.
h.category.filters/priceSteps: Amounts are in the smallest money unit (paisa). “Below” empty = no upper limit.
h.pdp.price/payLine/text: Not set = the shop’s own words.
h.thanks.look/enabled: Picks that go with what was bought.
h.thanks.celebrate/campaign: A new name celebrates again for people who saw an old one.
h.search.panel/popular: Shown before a visitor types. Empty = none.
h.store.currency: Three capital letters, like BDT. Only how amounts are written changes; no price is converted.
h.store.locale: For example bn-BD or en-GB. It decides how numbers and dates are written.
h.store.timeZone: For example Asia/Dhaka. Days, order times and quiet hours follow it.
h.language.bengali.digits: Off writes 0-9 on the Bengali shop too.
h.email.look/logo: No logo yet? The shop’s name is drawn instead (Website › Brand & menus).
h.email.look/header: For example a slogan. Not set = nothing.
h.email.look/footer: For example an address or a phone number, above the unsubscribe link. Not set = nothing.
h.email.look/accent: The line under the top and the links.
h.cookie.banner/policyLink: Opens the Cookie policy page (Website › Policies).
h.cookie.banner/declineStops: The shop’s own analytics and the ad beacons skip them.
h.app.homeScreen/shortName: Up to 12 letters, for small spaces. Not set = the name cut short.
h.app.homeScreen/icon: A square picture, at least 512 px. Not set = the shop’s tab icon.
h.app.homeScreen/themeColour: Not set = the shop’s background colour.
h.app.homeScreen/backgroundColour: Not set = the shop’s background colour.

o.cookie.banner/position=card: A small card in the corner
